svg.title: Trend discovery architecture
svg.desc: Four stages: cutoff-safe cached local embeddings; numerical grouping and activity selection; sampled Jev decisions with bounded reconciliation; configurable bilingual writing and Jev checks. Only reviewed matching original source IDs enter the output.
svg.text: From community messages to evidence-backed trends
Cache representations once. Group first. Spend language-model calls on bounded evidence.
No model calls in numerical selection
Future records stay out of grouping.
Geometry does not certify a topic.
One request for the whole packet.
One Jev request for the shortlist.
Check each title and optional action.
One request for the full draft.
Refine / merge / backfill within the review and token budgets
Cache hits skip inference. Replies, aliases and releases clarify evidence; image references supply counts, not pixels.
